## Summary

Describe the public-core change and the contract or user-visible behavior it affects.

## Validation

List the checks, fixtures, or manual review used.

## Public disclosure checklist

- [ ] This change is independently useful without `guitar-practice-platform`.
- [ ] It contains no customer, personal-practice, recording, telemetry, or production data.
- [ ] It contains no secrets, credentials, private endpoints, or production configuration.
- [ ] It does not disclose proprietary ranking, adaptation, evaluation, model-routing, or anti-abuse logic.
- [ ] Any prompt or algorithm added here is intentionally classified as a public reference baseline.
- [ ] Content and examples are synthetic, owned, public domain, or licensed for redistribution.
- [ ] The public repository does not import or depend on private source code.
- [ ] Cross-repository behavior is expressed through a generic, versioned contract.
- [ ] Product strategy, pricing, commercial roadmap, and unreleased premium content remain private.

When any item cannot be checked, move the work to the private repository or split out a smaller public interface.
